components.purpose: Top-of-page hero placed first on the Pricing page. Its Control tab (Heading, Description, Image, CallToAction, ImagePosition) holds Version A of the headline/image, and its Variants tab (nested ABTestHeroItem grid) holds Version B — the alternate headline/image to test. The ExperimentKey field ties both versions together into a single A/B experiment, directly fulfilling the request to test two versions of the headline and image at the top of the pricing page.
